pages.text: $(italic)Born of spider blood, Arachnids scale walls with ease and spin webs to ensnare their prey.$()$(br2)$(bold)Origin Traits:$()$(br2)$(bold)Wall Climbing$() — Scale vertical surfaces like a spider.$(br2)$(bold)Web Spinning$() — Spin webs to trap enemies.$(br2)$(bold)Meat Preference$() — $(warn)Non-meat foods provide 50% less nourishment$().
